topic: Day 107 — reel — Your life is the sum of what you repeated, not what you intended
text:
Your life is
what you
[repeated], not
what you meant.
caption:
Intentions that never turned into repetition don't show up in the result. That gap is where most of the disappointment lives.

Follow for one of these a day.
